claims.text: Fixed-script automated systems can't adapt to questions outside their configuration, compounding frustration
Black Arrow's platform threads every text and email per contact in one inbox so a human can take over with full context
The platform runs automated missed-call text-back as a speed-to-lead feature
Example acknowledgment-only auto-reply script with no price or scheduling promise
Dashboard shows weekly numbers including cost per lead and return on ad spend
Free in browser, up to 25 contacts, no signup, no card
